result_text:
I fixed the four broken default conventions in `ScopingConventions.java`, and added a test that covers them. The new test passes (5 of 5), and the existing `SourceFileFilterTest` and `SourceCodeFilesTest` still pass.

- **`.htm` pages:** the three generated-HTML rules (pkgdown, Doxygen, meta generator) now match `(html|htm|xhtml)`. The old `(html|html|xhtml)` had a doubled `html` where `htm` was meant.
- **.NET `<doc>` XML:** the path pattern is now `.*[.]xml` instead of `.*/[.]xml`, so `MyAssembly.xml` matches.
- **`// Generated by` JavaScript:** the path pattern is now `.*[.]js` instead of `.*/[.]js`, so `app.js` matches.
- **Gradle JavaScript:** the build-and-deployment pattern is now `.*[-]gradle[.]js` instead of `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` matches.

The new test is `codeanalyzer/src/test/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventionsTest.java`. It checks that the new cases match and that the existing ones (`.html`, `.xhtml`, `build.gradle`) still match. It also checks that hand-written `.htm`, `.js` and `.xml` files stay out of those scopes.

Nothing is committed.
